title: Riaan's zombie roar
blurb: The first sound on this board that a visitor made and sent in, rather than one we went looking for. Riaan recorded the roar himself. That is the whole reason it is here, because a zombie noise lifted off a film or a game would have been refused. It takes about three seconds to build, climbs the whole way, and then stops dead rather than fading, so it lands well against a jump cut. Useful for horror edits, Discord entrances, and startling somebody who has their volume up.
origin: Recorded by Riaan B., who sent it in through the upload form.
